service.name: Wedding cocktail hour music in Denver
service.serviceType: Live music for wedding cocktail hours in Denver
service.description: Jazz duo and solo guitarist bookings for wedding cocktail hours at Denver hotels, galleries, gardens, mansions and event floors, with no metro travel line.

faqs.q: What does setup look like at a downtown Denver venue?
faqs.a: It's small and early. A duo is one van and one trip: setup runs about 60 minutes and pack-down 45, through the service entrance, with dock windows and freight elevators settled with the banquet office before the day, so no cases cross the lobby. Where ceremony and reception share a building, the duo is set up and sound-checked before guests are seated. Signet Artists books Denver wedding cocktail hours.

faqs.q: What does the duo need for space, power and parking?
faqs.a: A corner of about 8 by 6 feet and one dedicated 20-amp circuit, and dedicated is the word that matters: sharing with catering warmers is the most common cause of trouble. Parking is settled at contract: a hotel dock has a window, a gallery has a curb, and either way the van is gone before guests arrive.

faqs.q: Is there a travel charge for a Denver wedding?
faqs.a: No. Denver is our home market, so a metro date carries no travel line. Travel appears on a quote only outside the metro: Boulder and Colorado Springs are a short Front Range line, and mountain venues carry their own.

faqs.q: Can the duo play an outdoor cocktail hour at a Denver garden venue?
faqs.a: Yes, on a covered, level and dry performance area with power run to it, and the move-indoors time written before the day, because Denver evenings get cold fast after sunset. Garden terraces with a pavilion make this the easiest outdoor booking on the calendar.

faqs.q: Is a duo enough for a cocktail hour at a Denver hotel?
faqs.a: Yes, for the guest counts these buildings hold at cocktail hour. Two musicians carry a lobby lounge or a mezzanine at a level guests who have just met can talk across. The trio is the size to book when the crowd spreads across a full ballroom.
